title: Choose the new rás visual direction
question: Which visual world should guide the household control room? All options keep the current workflows and make upcoming releases prominent.

options.label: Cinema showtime lightbox
options.lineage: Cinema foyer showtime panels and changeable film listings
options.thesis: The household sees its next releases as a living showtime schedule.
options.viewport: A broad upcoming schedule leads, with one large next release and a dated run beside it; decisions and live operations follow below.
options.risk: The cinema reference can become decorative if controls stop reading like practical software.

raised.raise: Every zone gets an unambiguous literal label, with no theatrical euphemism for its action.
Color stays confined to dates and state, so poster artwork keeps its own identity.
Time has a consistent axis across calendar, queue, and activity.
An actual failure can interrupt the quiet hierarchy at full scale.
Status changes are discrete and legible without implying that a waiting approval is a fault.

options.label: Electronic programme guide
options.lineage: Television's grid of channels, times, and current programmes
options.thesis: Every title has a place on a clear time axis, from next airing to available now.
options.viewport: A horizontal week band highlights the next releases; the active household decision sits in a separate lower lane.
options.risk: This familiar media pattern can feel like another streaming app if the grid becomes too busy.

options.label: Seven segment instrument
options.lineage: Bedside clocks, scoreboards, and equipment displays
options.thesis: Time and progress become unmistakable instrument readings.
options.viewport: An oversized date and countdown anchor the next release; scheduled titles occupy fixed instrument cells.
options.case: Glanceable timing is strong, but the household's film posters and decisions need more human space.
options.risk: If every label becomes a display cell, a useful dashboard starts to resemble a clock demo.

options.label: Industrial quoted labels
options.thesis: Every action carries a blunt, legible tag.
options.viewport: Large labeled courses put the next release under a stark marker.
options.case: Literal labels help clarity, but the stockroom does not identify the household's media experience.
options.risk: Hazard language may turn a welcome upcoming release into a warning.
options.kept: Literal labels for every zone and action.

options.label: Iridescent edge
options.lineage: A narrow color fringe at a cloud edge
options.thesis: A restrained band marks the next moment.
options.viewport: A quiet upcoming list lets date color appear only at the active edge.
options.case: Its calmness is useful, but the cloud form hides the media and decision model.
options.risk: It can become atmosphere without giving titles or actions clearer structure.

options.label: Labanotation score
options.lineage: Dance notation on a vertical staff
options.thesis: All activity climbs a shared time staff.
options.viewport: Upcoming releases rise through a center staff with decisions to either side.
options.case: Precise time is useful, but the specialized notation slows household reading.
options.risk: Users could mistake a designed code for a necessary task to decode.

options.label: Anime crisis wall
options.thesis: Every media event becomes a large system reading.
options.viewport: A giant countdown takes over the upcoming view while health data frames it.
options.case: It exposes status dramatically, but most household activity is routine and deliberate.
options.risk: An unchanged approval may read as a crisis or warning.
options.kept: Real failures may interrupt the quiet hierarchy.

options.label: Depot destination blind
options.thesis: The next date steps into a fixed schedule window.
options.viewport: A fixed window reveals upcoming titles in snapped courses.
options.case: The schedule is clear, but its stopped mid-step error metaphor conflicts with a deliberate waiting approval.
options.risk: Turning the approval shelf into a stuck mechanism would misstate the product.
options.kept: Discrete status changes without false urgency.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished media dashboard with conventional navigation and cards.
canonCard.viewport: Summary cards above a poster list, followed by approvals and activity.
canonCard.risk: Its hierarchy may make coming releases feel like one metric among many.
